artworks.title: Begrüssung (Greeting)
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on tan paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth Cole Kainen
artworks.description: The image features bold, flowing lines and rounded shapes in an abstract style. Two interconnected figures resembling women appear in the center, supported by dynamic curves. A smaller silhouette of a person riding a horse is in the lower left. Abstract swirling shapes above may represent trees or foliage, echoing the figures below. The composition blends human forms with natural elements, creating recognizable yet abstract figures and landscapes.

artworks.title: Reconciliation (Versoehnung)
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth Cole Kainen
artworks.description: The image shows bold lines and curves forming an abstract composition. Radiating lines converge toward a central crouched figure. Crescent shapes scattered nearby resemble moons or stars. The artwork includes a bending figure, curved lines resembling waves or shells, and swirling patterns at the bottom that resemble coiled snakes or vines.

artworks.title: Two Mythical Animals (Zwei Fabeltiere)
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth Cole Kainen
artworks.description: The image shows bold, curving lines and angular shapes in an abstract pattern on a light background. In the center, an arc-like shape resembles a large fruit, along with lines resembling stems or leaves. The upper portion features crescent-shaped curves, while vertical lines on the right suggest a tall figure or statue. The composition suggests natural or familiar objects through intersecting geometric forms.

artworks.title: Japanerin im Winterkleid (Japanese Woman in Winter Dress)
artworks.medium: drypoint with roulette in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth Cole Kainen
artworks.description: The image depicts the profile of a person facing left. The person has a calm expression, with a straight nose, closed lips, and closed eyes. They are wearing a headscarf that covers their hair and a dark garment below. The background has a textured surface with lines resembling cracks or branches.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross with Angels
artworks.medium: woodcut hand-colored with gouache, printed on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This image depicts a crucifixion scene with ornate decoration, including biblical figures in long robes with halos. Angels can be seen collecting blood in chalices, and the background features simple sky patterns. The border is intricately designed with floral and zoomorphic motifs, and a scroll with "INRI" is shown above the crucifixion. The painting is richly illuminated and resembles the style of medieval manuscript illumination.

artworks.title: Giovanni Gabrielli
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body. He is turned slightly to the right, with intense eye contact towards the viewer. The man has deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, a neatly groomed beard and mustache, and wavy hair styled upwards. He is wearing a collared shirt with a detailed cross-hatched vest. In his hands, he holds a theatrical mask, which has serene facial features. The background consists of tightly spaced horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Specimens of Gunshot Fractures of the Femur
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon
artworks.description: This is a photograph of two wooden walking staffs or canes. The image features two elongated objects with bulbous, rounded tops that resemble natural wooden staffs. Each staff is mounted on a simple wooden base against a dark, neutral background. The wooden surfaces display an intricate pattern of natural wood grain and knots, with visible cracks and irregularities. The photograph emphasizes the tactile and organic qualities of the wooden objects, showcasing their simplicity and rustic beauty. The stands at the bottom have numbered tags.

artworks.title: A Promenade in the Park at Sanssouci
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The painting depicts a promenade with a decorative stone railing lined with ornate urns running alongside a pathway that extends into the distance. The horizon is suggested where the pathway disappears into lush green vegetation in the background. The brushwork is detailed and realistic, capturing intricate stone carvings and foliage. The color palette consists of earthy tones for the stonework and various shades of green for the surrounding environment. A woman in a long black dress with a floral hat is positioned near the path's edge.

artworks.title: Maurice Quentin de la Tour
artworks.artist: Georg Friedrich Schmidt after Maurice-Quentin de La Tour
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchase of A. Thompson Ellwanger III for the Ellwanger/Mescha Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person from the upper half of their body, slightly off-center. The individual has a calm expression, distinct facial features, long curly hair under an elaborate hat, a cloak, and a ruffled shirt visible at the neckline. In front of them are books, documents, and a large sheet of paper with writing. In the background, there is an artist's studio with another figure working on a canvas, an ornately textured wall, and a framed object. The portrait is framed by an easel, hinting at a connection to the art world.

artworks.title: Reclining Female Nude
artworks.artist: Louis-Marin Bonnet after Louis Jean François Lagrenée
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchase of A. Thompson Ellwanger III for the Ellwanger/Mescha Collection
artworks.description: The image displays a person reclining on a fabric-covered surface. The individual is lying on their side, propped up by their left arm, with their right arm resting on their side. The person has closed eyes and a serene expression, with styled hair and is unclothed. They are surrounded by soft folds of fabric, with a textured pattern in the background.

artworks.title: Head of a Girl
artworks.artist: Louise Rosalie Hémery after Jean-Baptiste Greuze
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Gallery Girls
artworks.description: This image depicts a bust-length view of a young woman, shown from the shoulders up. Her head is slightly turned to her left, showing a three-quarter profile. The woman's facial features include large eyes gazing forward, a straight nose, full lips, and a soft expression. Her hair is wavy and parted in the middle, cascading down both sides of her face, and appears to be a rich brown shade. The clothing is subtly suggested around her shoulders, blending into the background. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects being held by her. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the contours and features of her face. The image is rendered in sepia tones.

artworks.title: Musicians Traveling through a Forest
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a view from a high vantage point over a forested area. The horizon is hidden by trees and the ground slopes gently away into the distance. The trees are detailed and have an ethereal texture. A large, twisted tree is in the foreground and there are figures in the middle ground. In the background, there is a hint of ruins or an old structure. The color scheme is predominantly sepia, creating a timeless and serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Happy Squire and His Bride
artworks.medium: brush and gray wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring two elegantly dressed figures surrounded by swirling decorative lines and shapes. The background is dark, highlighting the figures and their attire. A bird flies above them, while winged cherubic figures surround them. A large pole-like structure extends from the top right. In the lower section, faint outlines of a distant landscape with a church spire are visible. The drawing uses dark tones and fine pencil work to create depth and whimsy.

artworks.title: Kneeling Pages, a Mask, and a Parrot
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [artist's working proof]
artworks.creditLine: The Ahmanson Foundation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a collection of objects including figures, a parrot, and decorative vases. The drawing features a sculpted face, three figures in elaborate attire, and a parrot perched on a structure. Ornate vases and a smaller sculpture are positioned nearby. The style evokes a sense of baroque richness with a focus on fanciful decorations and a lively composition.

artworks.title: Ixion
artworks.artist: Hendrik Goltzius after Cornelis Cornelisz van Haarlem
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 30.9 cm (12 3/16 in.) (round, cut within platemark)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Hack
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a muscular figure suspended in midair amidst swirling clouds and fiery waves below. The form is depicted with dynamic anatomy, showcasing muscles and a contorted expression. The background features elements, with curling clouds part of a storm, and waves crashing beneath. This artwork conveys a sense of action and emotion, evoking themes of struggle and chaos.

artworks.title: The Judgment of Solomon
artworks.artist: Willem Swanenburgh after Joachim Anthonisz Wtewael
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Hack
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people in a dramatic scene, centered around a confrontation involving soldiers and an unarmed person. The scene takes place in an architectural setting with classical columns. In the image, a figure is kneeling on the ground while another figure holds an object above their head, with other characters looking on. The figures are depicted with serious expressions. The drawing includes richly detailed clothing and fabric.

artworks.title: Mademoiselle Trachier
artworks.medium: albumen silver print (sheet of 8 uncut cartes-de-visite)
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image portrays a young girl in multiple identical frames arranged as a stereoscopic card. In the upper row, she is seated on a fringed upholstered chair next to a decorative column. She is facing forward with her legs crossed and arms resting on the armrests. The girl has a youthful face with straight hair parted neatly, wearing a knee-length dress with a bold pattern, stockings, and shoes. In the lower row, she is standing on the chair next to the column, dressed similarly. A draped cloth or curtain is partially visible behind the column. The background is neutral with a patterned floor underneath.

artworks.title: Monsieur Jadin and Son
artworks.medium: albumen silver print (sheet of 8 uncut cartes-de-visite)
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image displays eight photographs arranged in two rows. The first row features pairs of Victorian-era individuals - an older man and a younger man. The older man is bald with a beard, dressed formally, leaning against a column. The younger man, also in formal attire, stands by a balustrade and seems to be writing or drawing. The second row shows the same younger man alone in different poses next to the column and balustrade. He wears a similar outfit, including a bow tie, and holds either a top hat and walking stick or a book. The background consists of a plain wall with decorative pillars and a balustrade, set in a formal interior with a patterned floor.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross with the Virgin and Saint John
artworks.artist: Augsburg 15th Century (and attributed to Hans Burgkmair?)
artworks.medium: color woodcut printed from five blocks on vellum, hand-colored with gouache
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting the crucifixion. The central figure is on a cross and has wounds with blood flowing. Two figures with halos stand at the base of the cross, one in a nun's habit and the other in red and green robes. The ground is scattered with bones and a skull. The art style features outlined figures with bold colors and a simplified design, characteristic of medieval religious illustrations. It is reminiscent of medieval woodcuts or religious iconography from the late Middle Ages.

artworks.title: Plant Study
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: There are broad, round leaves with a textured surface. The leaves are growing densely along the ground with some overlapping. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of sepia and brown. The leaves start from the bottom left, spread across the bottom, and fill up the center and right side of the image, appearing to emerge from a textured background.

artworks.title: Hoarfrost, a Park Scene
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a view from a slightly elevated position overlooking a small formal garden area. The horizon is not visible, with a cluster of leafless trees dominating the scene. The frosted branches of the tall trees suggest a wintry setting. In the foreground, there is a sculpted stone edge with urns at both ends, adding to the structure. More frosted trees can be seen extending into the distance, enhancing the serenity of the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, with soft grays and whites, creating a timeless and tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: A Minstrel Group
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: Three individuals are depicted in the image. The central figure is a girl holding a stringed musical instrument that resembles a lute. She has mid-length wavy hair peeking out from under a cap and wears a light, long-sleeved blouse with a floral brooch and a striped skirt. To her right, another young girl with longer, slightly curly hair leans towards the central figure, wearing a dark, simple outfit. On the left, a young woman with her head tilted downwards stands next to the central girl. Her hair is styled in an updo with flowers and a ribbon. She is dressed in a velvet garment with an intricate collar and long sleeves, reminiscent of medieval attire. A plain, dark drape serves as the background for the figures.

artworks.title: At Winterdyne on the Severn
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image features a path next to an ivy-covered stone structure resembling a castle wall. The viewpoint is ground level, showing the textures of the path and surrounding foliage. Vegetation and the structure obscure the horizon, creating a secluded atmosphere. Trees with twisted branches grow around the path. The black-and-white presentation gives a timeless quality. The monochromatic color palette uses sepia tones for a vintage aesthetic. A figure in old-fashioned attire stands near the wall, providing scale and a human element in the natural and historical setting.

artworks.title: Bridge near Betws-y-Coed
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Richard King Mellon Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on a rocky bank near a river, holding a small object. Smooth, polished rocks line the river banks. The river flows gently past the man, bordered by large rock formations and thickly forested areas. Trees with dense foliage cover the landscape. The horizon is barely visible above the treetops, featuring a distant hill or embankment on the right side. The photo is dominated by shades of brown and gray, creating a peaceful atmosphere. The water appears smooth, while the rocks and foliage show sharp details, hinting at a long exposure technique.
